description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange effective from 11.02.2019 to 17.03.2019
categorisation: This gazette notification is a Customs Notification issued under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235). It sets new official exchange rates for calculating customs duties and other charges, and rescinds a previous notification. This content pertains to the establishment of a regulatory framework and compliance requirements for customs operations, which falls squarely under the Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5) for regulatory matters and statutory instruments.
